project.name: osgi/jgiven/jgiven-probe-test
project.description: The -test fragment of the guard, the template a real host (doctor-core) copies: a Fragment-Host attached to jgiven-probe, authored IN THE HOST'S PACKAGE so it reads Vault's package-private balance white-box. Its bnd writes only Fragment-Host + a one-line -include of the shared jgiven-fragment.bnd; the forced com.tngtech.jgiven.impl.intercept import + the wildcard tail come from there. bnd computes the rest (jGiven + byte-buddy) from the scenario bytecode; those merge into the host at resolution (OSGi Core §3.14). Running the scenario through the host classloader proves jGiven plays in-container thanks to jgiven-testkit + jgiven-wrap: byte-buddy injects the stage proxy into the host loader, reachable because the fragment contributed net.bytebuddy.* to the host.
